decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a cheap extension of the established map.apps platform, so its absence from the website since 2019 points to low visibility rather than a clear shortfall against aspirations, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm keep carrying it.

The hierarchical search bundle has had only minor visibility and none since 2019, which makes it a candidate for consolidation, but it is close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, so there is no strong trigger for problemistic search.
As the flagship platform line that defines the firm's strategic direction, it anchors aspirations rather than being judged against them, so management stays committed despite less website attention.

The search extension complements the web map apps and needs few resources, so even with reduced visibility since 2019 the firm's slack supports keeping it, though it may later be merged into other search components.
